types.label: 401(k)
types.note: Employer plan; contributions usually pre-tax. Check for an employer match.

types.label: 403(b)
types.note: Employer plan for non-profits and schools.

types.label: Traditional IRA
types.note: Contributions may be deductible; withdrawals are taxed.

types.label: Roth IRA
types.note: After-tax contributions; qualified withdrawals are tax-free.

types.label: HSA
types.note: Health savings account; qualified medical withdrawals are tax-free.

types.label: Taxable brokerage
types.note: Dividends and realised gains are taxed each year.

types.label: 529 plan
types.note: Education savings; qualified withdrawals are tax-free.
